title: Normal Lymph Node
source: Wikimedia Commons; photographer's original Flickr record also accessed
modifications: none; original Commons JPEG downloaded unchanged
species: Not explicitly stated in photographer/Commons prose; clinical colectomy context suggests human, but do not label confirmed human
specimen_context: Photographer calls this a normal lymph node from a colectomy specimen. Normal designation applies to this node, not a claim that the donor or colon was healthy.
modality_preparation: Light microscopy photograph of a tissue section. H&E is identified in the Commons Polish description; fixation and section thickness unknown.
color: Pink/purple stain-dependent appearance, not natural tissue color
calibration: No scale bar or physical calibration supplied; EXIF 300 dpi is a display/print setting, not tissue scale
observed_content: Actual JPEG inspected: broad oval lymphoid tissue section with pink peripheral capsule and pale space beneath it, surrounding pale adipose profiles, and peripheral rounded dark aggregates. Some edges meet the circular microscope field; do not claim the entire intact node or hilum is shown.
purpose: Observed normal-designated nodal tissue architecture: capsule, subcapsular sinus and peripheral follicle context, beside a separately labeled whole-node teaching reconstruction
limits: A fixed two-dimensional section does not establish three-dimensional whole-node geometry, all compartments, hilum or afferent/efferent vessels; does not identify B/T cells or flow/immune timing. Normal designation is photographer-supplied, not an independent pathology reassessment.
source_access: Commons file page, original photographer Flickr page and direct Commons original image accessed successfully; license and source description observed; actual JPEG viewed
status: Source identity, stated license and acquisition facts verified on 2026-11-04; current chapter acceptance is recorded in the chapter sidecar.
